text:
maria_sec: Auditor asked for a concise end-to-end sample proving RBAC change + KMS decrypts for inference-service. Scope: production only, last 30 days, ten users. Need approval artifacts, deploy manifest hash, k8s audit snippet, KMS logs, and two correlated API traces. Deadline EOD.

auditor_jane: Confirming: raw JSON snippets + short mapping to SOC2/ISO control IDs (CC6 / A.9). MD5 checksums preferred for files.

tom_infra: I can export RoleBinding diffs and attach CHG/JIRA ticket. Will include PR link and deploy SHA. Need the 10-user list.

sam_sre: For KMS decrypts I'll pull cloud audit logs. Splunk query I'll use: index=prod_kms action=Decrypt earliest=-30d@d | fields user,keyName,requestId,timestamp | head 200. That yields request_ids to correlate.

olivia_prod: I'll post 10 users across API/frontend/infra in the ticket. Note: two of them were in the canary rollout on 2025-11-14.

maria_sec: Tom: include approval emails (redacted) and the canary window notes. Sam: include 3 sample KMS entries and two full http traces correlated by x-rw-request-id.

tom_infra: Added CHG-1501, PR-4630, deploy SHA: b7e9f2a. k8s audit snippet (sanitized): {"verb":"update","objectRef":{"resource":"rolebindings","name":"inference-readers"},"user":"deploy-bot","timestamp":"2025-11-14T15:22:58Z"}

sam_sre: KMS snippets (sanitized): user: olivia@redwood.com key: projects/p1/.../inference-key action: Decrypt request_id: req-4f2a ts:2025-11-14T15:23:03Z; user: bob@redwood.com request_id: req-6a9c ts:2025-11-20T09:11:44Z; user: erin@redwood.com request_id: req-9c1d ts:2025-11-21T18:02:10Z.

auditor_jane: Good. For each request_id include the API log entry showing x-rw-request-id header so we can see the chain: approval -> role change -> deploy -> KMS decrypt -> API call. Two full examples are sufficient.

sam_sre: Correlation query for http logs: index=prod_http x-rw-request-id=REQID | table _time, client_ip, path, status, request_id, user_email. I'll attach two full traces as JSON in the bundle.

olivia_prod: Sample users posted in the ticket: olivia, bob, erin, carol, dave, frank, grace, harry, isabel, jack. Emails attached.

maria_sec: Also include gcloud export of key IAM and rotation metadata: gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy inference-key --location=global --keyring=inference-ring --format=json. Auditor requested who has decrypt rights.

tom_infra: Included policy snippet and rotation schedule screenshot. Also added a short README mapping files to control IDs.

sam_sre: Noting vuln triage: removing broad cluster-admin binding broke a sidecar; mitigation ticket TICKET-672 documents the fix and timeline. There was a brief error spike during canary (INC-2025-349). Adding that to context.

auditor_jane: Include the vuln triage ticket and mitigation evidence; good to have timeline and acceptance notes. Also please provide MD5 checksums and a signed manifest.

maria_sec: security-bot: please package bundle and generate manifest + md5. Sign manifest with our key.

security-bot: Automated: bundle created id=bndl-20251115-33, manifest produced, md5 checksums calculated, GPG signature attached, uploaded to s3://redwood-evidence/exports/bndl-20251115-33.zip.gpg.

auditor_jane: Received presigned link via ticket. I'll validate signature and mapping doc and will follow up if anything missing (likely ask for 30-day GKE audit export proof).

maria_sec: Noted. If auditor requests export retention proof we'll attach the GKE audit export policy. Estimated close after auditor ack. Thanks team!
